description: This file implements the class 'nusoap_parser', which parses SOAP XML messages into PHP data structures, including handling of SOAP envelopes, headers, bodies, and complex/simple types. It also provides backward compatibility with 'soap_parser'. The parser reads XML payloads, processes XML elements, and builds PHP representations of SOAP responses.

classes.name: nusoap_parser
classes.description: A class for parsing SOAP XML messages into PHP native data structures, handling namespaces, types, arrays, and complex objects.

methods.name: get_response
methods.description: Returns the parsed SOAP body response message.

methods.name: get_soapbody
methods.description: Returns the SOAP body after parsing; null if not available.

methods.name: get_soapheader
methods.description: Returns the parsed SOAP header; null if not present.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the unparsed SOAP headers as raw XML text.

methods.name: decodeSimple
methods.description: Decodes simple XML types into corresponding PHP variables based on the type and namespace.

methods.name: buildVal
methods.description: Builds PHP data structures from parsed XML nodes, handling complex types like arrays, structs, maps, and scalar values.

methods.name: start_element
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element during parsing, updating the node tree and managing namespaces, types, and message structure.

methods.name: end_element
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, completing complex types, resolving references, and constructing PHP values.

methods.name: character_data
methods.description: Handles character data inside XML elements, accumulating text content.
